# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Introduction
# ------------------------------------------------------------
This analysis aims to predict monthly rental prices in Tokyo's 23 wards using LightGBM.

Two approaches are used: predicting rent directly and predicting rent per square meter.

Models are trained with multiple random seeds, and their predictions are combined using a weighted average to improve predictive accuracy.



# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Libraries
# ------------------------------------------------------------
```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(lightgbm)
```



# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Load Data
# ------------------------------------------------------------
```{r load_data}
# Load the preprocessed training dataset
df <- read.csv(
  "processed_train_data.csv",
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM"
)
```



# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Evaluation Metrics
# ------------------------------------------------------------
```{r evaluation_metrics}
# Root Mean Squared Error
rmse <- function(actual, predicted) {
  sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}


# Mean Absolute Error
mae <- function(actual, predicted) {
  mean(abs(actual - predicted), na.rm = TRUE)
}
```



# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Preprocessing Functions
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5.1 Group Stations
```{r group_stations}
group_stations <- function(train, valid) {

  station_counts <- table(train$station_1)

  few_stations <- names(
    station_counts[station_counts <= 5]
  )

  train$station_1_grouped <- as.character(train$station_1)
  valid$station_1_grouped <- as.character(valid$station_1)

  train$station_1_grouped[
    train$station_1_grouped %in% few_stations
  ] <- "other"

  train_levels <- unique(train$station_1_grouped)

  valid$station_1_grouped[
    !(valid$station_1_grouped %in% train_levels)
  ] <- "other"

  list(train = train, valid = valid)
}
```


# 5.2 Group Towns
```{r group_towns}
group_towns <- function(train, valid) {

  town_counts <- table(train$town)

  few_towns <- names(
    town_counts[town_counts <= 10]
  )

  train$town_grouped_18 <- as.character(train$town)
  valid$town_grouped_18 <- as.character(valid$town)

  special_towns <- c("南千住", "佃", "有明")

  train$town_grouped_18[
    train$town_grouped_18 %in% few_towns |
      train$town_grouped_18 %in% special_towns
  ] <- "other"

  train_levels <- unique(train$town_grouped_18)

  valid$town_grouped_18[
    !(valid$town_grouped_18 %in% train_levels)
  ] <- "other"

  list(train = train, valid = valid)
}
```


# 5.3 Group Layouts
```{r group_layouts}
group_layouts <- function(train, valid) {

  layout_counts <- table(train$layout)

  few_layouts <- names(
    layout_counts[layout_counts <= 5]
  )

  train$layout_grouped <- as.character(train$layout)
  valid$layout_grouped <- as.character(valid$layout)

  train$layout_grouped[
    train$layout_grouped %in% few_layouts
  ] <- "other"

  train_levels <- unique(train$layout_grouped)

  valid$layout_grouped[
    !(valid$layout_grouped %in% train_levels)
  ] <- "other"

  list(train = train, valid = valid)
}
```


# 5.4 Missing Value Imputation
```{r impute_missing}
impute_missing <- function(train, valid) {

  cols <- c("building_age", "floor", "total_floor")

  for (col in cols) {

    
    # Calculate median using training data only
    median_value <- median(train[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)

    
    # Create missing value indicators
    missing_col <- paste0(col, "_missing")

    train[[missing_col]] <- as.integer(is.na(train[[col]]))
    valid[[missing_col]] <- as.integer(is.na(valid[[col]]))

    
    # Apply training median to both datasets
    train[[col]][is.na(train[[col]])] <- median_value
    valid[[col]][is.na(valid[[col]])] <- median_value
  }

  list(train = train, valid = valid)
}
```



# 5.5 Kitchen Features
```{r preprocess_kitchen_cv}
preprocess_kitchen_cv <- function(train, valid) {

  
  # Replace missing stove types
  train$stove_type <- as.character(train$stove_type)
  valid$stove_type <- as.character(valid$stove_type)

  train$stove_type[is.na(train$stove_type)] <- "missing"
  valid$stove_type[is.na(valid$stove_type)] <- "missing"

  
  # Impute burner count
  median_value <- median(train$burner_count, na.rm = TRUE)

  train$burner_count_missing <- as.integer(
    is.na(train$burner_count)
  )

  valid$burner_count_missing <- as.integer(
    is.na(valid$burner_count)
  )

  train$burner_count[is.na(train$burner_count)] <- median_value
  valid$burner_count[is.na(valid$burner_count)] <- median_value

  list(train = train, valid = valid)
}
```


# 5.6 Walking Times
```{r preprocess_walk_cv}
preprocess_walk_cv <- function(train, valid) {

  cols <- c("walk_2", "walk_3")

  for (col in cols) {

    median_value <- median(train[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)

    missing_col <- paste0(col, "_missing")

    train[[missing_col]] <- as.integer(is.na(train[[col]]))
    valid[[missing_col]] <- as.integer(is.na(valid[[col]]))

    train[[col]][is.na(train[[col]])] <- median_value
    valid[[col]][is.na(valid[[col]])] <- median_value
  }

  list(train = train, valid = valid)
}
```


# 5.7 Parking Features
```{r preprocess_parking_cv}
preprocess_parking_cv <- function(train, valid) {

  
  # Parking status
  train$parking_status <- as.character(train$parking_status)
  valid$parking_status <- as.character(valid$parking_status)

  train$parking_status[is.na(train$parking_status)] <- "missing"
  valid$parking_status[is.na(valid$parking_status)] <- "missing"

  
  # Bicycle parking status
  train$bicycle_parking_grouped <- as.character(
    train$bicycle_parking_status
  )

  valid$bicycle_parking_grouped <- as.character(
    valid$bicycle_parking_status
  )

  train$bicycle_parking_grouped[
    is.na(train$bicycle_parking_grouped)
  ] <- "missing"

  valid$bicycle_parking_grouped[
    is.na(valid$bicycle_parking_grouped)
  ] <- "missing"

  train$bicycle_parking_grouped[
    train$bicycle_parking_grouped %in% c("nearby", "unavailable")
  ] <- "other"

  valid$bicycle_parking_grouped[
    valid$bicycle_parking_grouped %in% c("nearby", "unavailable")
  ] <- "other"

  
  list(train = train, valid = valid)
}
```


# 5.8 Contract Features
```{r preprocess_contract_cv}
preprocess_contract_cv <- function(train, valid) {

  train$fixed_term[is.na(train$fixed_term)] <- 0
  valid$fixed_term[is.na(valid$fixed_term)] <- 0

  list(train = train, valid = valid)
}
```


# 5.9 Align Categories
```{r align_categories}
align_categories <- function(train, valid, cols) {

  for (col in cols) {

    train[[col]] <- as.character(train[[col]])
    valid[[col]] <- as.character(valid[[col]])

    
    # Replace missing values
    train[[col]][is.na(train[[col]])] <- "missing"
    valid[[col]][is.na(valid[[col]])] <- "missing"

    
    # Identify unseen categories
    train_levels <- unique(train[[col]])
    unknown <- !(valid[[col]] %in% train_levels)

    
    # Replace unseen categories
    if (any(unknown)) {
      replacement <- if ("other" %in% train_levels) {
        "other"
      } else {
        NA_character_
      }

      valid[[col]][unknown] <- replacement
    }
  }

  
  list(train = train, valid = valid)
}
```



# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Combine Preprocessing Functions
# ------------------------------------------------------------
```{r prepare_cv_data}
prepare_cv_data <- function(train, valid) {

  data <- group_stations(train, valid)
  data <- group_towns(data$train, data$valid)
  data <- group_layouts(data$train, data$valid)

  data <- impute_missing(data$train, data$valid)
  data <- preprocess_kitchen_cv(data$train, data$valid)
  data <- preprocess_walk_cv(data$train, data$valid)
  data <- preprocess_parking_cv(data$train, data$valid)
  data <- preprocess_contract_cv(data$train, data$valid)

  data <- align_categories(
    data$train,
    data$valid,
    cols = c(
      "station_1_grouped",
      "town_grouped_18",
      "layout_grouped",
      "stove_type",
      "parking_status",
      "bicycle_parking_grouped",
      "ward",
      "building_structure"
    )
  )

  
  return(data)
}
```




# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Model Training and Evaluation
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7.1 Model Setup
```{r final_model_setup}
# LightGBM parameters
params_rent <- list(
  objective = "regression",
  metric = "rmse",
  learning_rate = 0.05,
  num_leaves = 31,
  min_data_in_leaf = 30,
  feature_fraction = 0.9,
  bagging_fraction = 0.9,
  bagging_freq = 1,
  verbosity = -1,
  num_threads = 4
)

params_sqm <- params_rent
params_sqm$num_leaves <- 127


# Ensemble seeds
seeds <- c(456, 789, 123, 2026)


# Number of boosting rounds
nrounds_rent <- 1400
nrounds_sqm <- 1383
```



# 7.2 Layout Feature Engineering
```{r layout_features}
process_layout <- function(data) {

  data$room_count <- as.numeric(
    stringr::str_extract(data$layout, "^\\d+")
  )

  data$has_L <- as.integer(
    stringr::str_detect(data$layout, "L")
  )

  data$has_D <- as.integer(
    stringr::str_detect(data$layout, "D")
  )

  data$has_K <- as.integer(
    stringr::str_detect(data$layout, "K")
  )

  data$has_S <- as.integer(
    stringr::str_detect(data$layout, "S")
  )

  data
}
```


# 7.3 Prepare LightGBM Data
```{r prepare_lgb_data}
prepare_lgb_data <- function(train, valid, feature_cols) {

  train_x <- train[, feature_cols, drop = FALSE]
  valid_x <- valid[, feature_cols, drop = FALSE]

  cat_cols <- character(0)

  for (col in feature_cols) {

    if (is.character(train_x[[col]]) ||
        is.factor(train_x[[col]])) {

      cat_cols <- c(cat_cols, col)

      
      # Encode categories using training levels
      levels_train <- unique(
        as.character(train_x[[col]])
      )

      levels_train <- levels_train[!is.na(levels_train)]

      train_x[[col]] <- match(
        as.character(train_x[[col]]),
        levels_train
      ) - 1L

      valid_x[[col]] <- match(
        as.character(valid_x[[col]]),
        levels_train
      ) - 1L
    }

    if (is.logical(train_x[[col]])) {
      train_x[[col]] <- as.integer(train_x[[col]])
      valid_x[[col]] <- as.integer(valid_x[[col]])
    }
  }

  list(
    train = data.matrix(train_x),
    valid = data.matrix(valid_x),
    cat_cols = cat_cols
  )
}
```


# 7.4 Prepare Training and Test Data
```{r prepare_final_data}
# Load the preprocessed test dataset
processed_test <- read.csv(
  "processed_test_data.csv",
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM"
)


# Exclude specific training observations
train_raw <- df |>
  dplyr::filter(!id %in% c(5776, 7492))


# Apply preprocessing using training data
prepared <- prepare_cv_data(
  train_raw,
  processed_test
)


# Create layout features
tr <- process_layout(prepared$train)
te <- process_layout(prepared$valid)


# Select model features
exclude_cols <- c("id", "rent", "rent_per_sqm", "fold_id")

feature_cols <- setdiff(names(tr), exclude_cols)

supported <- vapply(
  tr[feature_cols],
  function(x) {
    is.numeric(x) ||
      is.character(x) ||
      is.factor(x) ||
      is.logical(x)
  },
  logical(1)
)

feature_cols <- feature_cols[supported]
feature_cols <- intersect(feature_cols, names(te))


# Convert features to matrices
mats <- prepare_lgb_data(
  tr,
  te,
  feature_cols
)


# Check data
stopifnot(
  nrow(mats$train) == nrow(tr),
  nrow(mats$valid) == nrow(te),
  ncol(mats$train) == ncol(mats$valid),
  all(is.finite(tr$rent)),
  all(is.finite(tr$area)),
  all(tr$area > 0),
  all(is.finite(te$area)),
  all(te$area > 0)
)
```


# 7.5 Train Ensemble Models
```{r train_final_ensemble}
# Initialize predictions
pred_rent <- numeric(nrow(te))
pred_sqm <- numeric(nrow(te))

for (s in seeds) {

  cat("\nTraining with seed:", s, "\n")

  
  # Model A: Direct rent prediction
  params_rent$seed <- s

  dtrain_rent <- lgb.Dataset(
    data = mats$train,
    label = tr$rent,
    categorical_feature = mats$cat_cols
  )

  model_rent <- lgb.train(
    params = params_rent,
    data = dtrain_rent,
    nrounds = nrounds_rent,
    verbose = -1
  )

  pred_rent <- pred_rent +
    predict(model_rent, mats$valid) / length(seeds)

  
  # Model B: Rent per square meter prediction
  params_sqm$seed <- s

  dtrain_sqm <- lgb.Dataset(
    data = mats$train,
    label = tr$rent / tr$area,
    categorical_feature = mats$cat_cols
  )

  model_sqm <- lgb.train(
    params = params_sqm,
    data = dtrain_sqm,
    nrounds = nrounds_sqm,
    verbose = -1
  )

  pred_sqm <- pred_sqm +
    (
      predict(model_sqm, mats$valid) * te$area
    ) / length(seeds)
}
```


# 7.6 Blend Predictions
```{r blend_predictions}
# Blend direct rent and rent-per-sqm predictions
pred_final <- 0.3 * pred_rent + 0.7 * pred_sqm


# Ensure non-negative predictions
pred_final <- pmax(pred_final, 0)

summary(pred_final)
```


# 7.7 Prediction Summary
```{r prediction_summary}
# Compare predictions from the three approaches
prediction_summary <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Direct Rent", "Price per sqm", "Blend"),
  Mean_Prediction = c(
    mean(pred_rent),
    mean(pred_sqm),
    mean(pred_final)
  ),
  Median_Prediction = c(
    median(pred_rent),
    median(pred_sqm),
    median(pred_final)
  )
)

knitr::kable(prediction_summary, digits = 0)
```


# 7.8 Findings

The final predictions combine direct rent estimation (30%) and rent-per-square-meter estimation (70%).

Predictions are averaged across four random seeds to reduce dependence on individual model runs.

# 8.1 Create Submission File
```{r create_submission}
# Create submission dataframe
submission <- data.frame(
  id = te$id,
  rent = pred_final
)


# Check prediction values
stopifnot(
  nrow(submission) == nrow(te),
  !anyNA(submission$rent),
  all(is.finite(submission$rent)),
  anyDuplicated(submission$id) == 0
)


# Align submission IDs with the sample submission file
sample_submit <- read.csv(
  "sample_submit.csv",
  header = FALSE
)

submission <- data.frame(
  id = sample_submit$V1,
  rent = submission$rent[
    match(sample_submit$V1, submission$id)
  ]
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(submission) == nrow(sample_submit),
  !anyNA(submission$rent),
  all(is.finite(submission$rent))
)


# Save submission without column headers
write.table(
  submission,
  file = "submission.csv",
  sep = ",",
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE
)

cat("Submission file saved successfully.\n")
```
